clauses.evidence: E01-S03#AC4,AC5 (AC5 has hidden dependency on E01-S05, see finding)
E01-S05#AC7 (no concrete odd-chip example, see MEDIUM finding)
E01-S07#AC1,AC2 (hands, seed, size), E01-S16#AC6 (game); line-up/style/advice options in E06/E07

findings.location: E01-S01 DoD#3,#6,#10 (global DoD on all E01-S01..S06)
findings.evidence: Global DoD #10 'CI workflow is green on the story's branch' applies to E01-S01, but the workflow is built by E01-S02, which depends on E01-S01 (cycle). DoD #6 '10,000-hand playtest reports zero invariant violations' applies to E01-S02..S06 (they touch the engine) but the playtest only exists after E01-S07/S08. DoD #3 'golden-spot suite passes 100%' has no suite until E07-S14.
findings.fix: Scope the DoD items so they cannot be required before the tool exists (e.g. attach the CI-green and playtest items only to stories ordered after E01-S02 / E01-S08, or make S01 DoD exclude them), or reorder so CI/playtest come before the stories that must satisfy them.

findings.evidence: AC5 replays 'a recorded hand's replay code, seats, stacks, button and actions' and checks hole cards and board; this needs the hand engine of E01-S05, but E01-S03 depends only on E01-S01 and E01-S05 depends on E01-S03.
findings.fix: Move the full-hand replay AC to E01-S05 (tagged REQ-013.3) and keep S03 AC4 (same code -> identical deck), or add a dependency on S05 and reorder.

findings.evidence: AC7 states the odd-dollar rule abstractly with no concrete pot, no seats and no expected payouts, so it would pass with a trivial even split. REQ-019.3 also says 'or chip', i.e. sit-and-go chips, not covered.
findings.fix: Add a concrete AC: Given a $27 pot tied by seats 2 and 5 with the button at seat 1, When awarded, Then seat 2 receives $14 and seat 5 receives $13; add the same for a sit-and-go chip pot and for a tied side pot.

findings.evidence: AC3 says only 'the cap applies exactly as with more players' with no heads-up values. Heads-up preflop (button posts SB, BB counts as first bet) is the case most likely to be wrong, yet no amounts or legal-action set are given.
findings.fix: Rewrite: Given a heads-up $4/$8 hand, When the button raises to $8, BB re-raises to $12 and the button raises to $16, Then the BB may only call or fold.

findings.evidence: AC6 requires a playtest `--game sng` mode where busted seats stay empty and a new sit-and-go starts, but the story says starting chips (1,500) and the level schedule belong to E05; S16 has no dependency on E05 and gives no starting stacks or limits for this mode, so an implementer must guess. E01-S17#AC1 then runs 'sit-and-go' over sizes 2-10 on the same undefined basis.
findings.fix: State the stack and limit assumptions for the interim sng mode (e.g. 1,500 chips at fixed L1 20/40) or add the E05 dependency; note E05 must reuse the same mode.

findings.evidence: Description says 'The engine exposes the legal action set with exact amounts for the player to act' and E01-S06 relies on legal actions in PlayerView, yet no AC in S05 (or S06#AC1) verifies the legal set or amounts.
findings.fix: Add an AC to S05: Given a hand at $4/$8 preflop facing the BB, When the engine lists legal actions for the first actor, Then they are fold, call $4 and raise to $8.

findings.evidence: Notes state 'a mucking player forfeits claim to all pots' with side pots, but no AC exercises it; behaviour is untested.
findings.fix: Add an AC with a side-pot hand where a bot mucks and a lower pot is awarded to the next best hand, or drop the note.

findings.location: E01-S01, E01-S02 descriptions; actor in S06, S07, S08, S17
findings.evidence: S01 and S02 are chores with no 'As a ..., I want ..., so that ...' sentence; S06-S08 and S17 use the actor 'maintainer', which is not a user class in requirements.md (only Learner).
findings.fix: Add a so-that benefit to the chores and either use Learner or note the maintainer actor as a project-owner role.

findings.evidence: AC2 runs the 1,000,000-hand job as one CI job; at the permitted worst case of 100,000 hands per 60 minutes this is about 10 hours, over the 6-hour limit of a GitHub-hosted job.
findings.fix: Specify sharding of the nightly run into parallel jobs/batches with deterministic per-shard seeds.

summary: All 50 clauses in scope covered by tagged ACs with real fail conditions. Two HIGH hidden-dependency findings (global DoD items that cannot be met before CI/playtest exist; S03 replay AC needing the S05 engine), three MEDIUM AC-quality issues, four LOW.
